note: Views Row Insert provides one Views style plugin id 'row_insert' (Drupal\views_row_insert\Plugin\views\style\ViewsRowInsert). No configure route (configure=null). State lives in the view config entity display.<id>.display_options.style (type: row_insert, options: use_plugin/data_mode/block_name/custom_row_data/rows_number/row_header/row_footer/row_limit_flag/row_limit/class_name/row_class/default_rows/strip_rows). Config schema views.style.row_insert. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real view config: introspection reads back the style options of a seeded view; execution switches a view display's style to row_insert / reconfigures its options, verified against the live view entity. The declared permission 'administer views row insert' is unused in code.

evals.prompt: In Drupal, I want to inject a Google AdSense block or some custom HTML into a view's results after every few rows. What does the views_row_insert module give me and where in a view do I turn it on?
evals.expected_output: It adds a Views style plugin 'Row Insert' (id row_insert). You select it under the view display's Format section, choose Block or Custom content, and set 'Insert after every Nth row'. There is no separate admin settings page.

evals.prompt: For the views_row_insert 'Row Insert' style, which option controls how often the extra row is inserted, and which option holds the custom HTML that gets inserted? Name the option keys.
evals.expected_output: rows_number sets 'insert after every Nth row'; custom_row_data holds the custom HTML (used when data_mode = vri_text). For a block instead, data_mode = vri_block and block_name selects the block.

evals.prompt: In views_row_insert, how do I tell it to insert a Drupal block versus arbitrary custom HTML, and is the custom HTML sanitized?
evals.expected_output: The data_mode option chooses the source: vri_block inserts the block picked in block_name, vri_text inserts custom_row_data. The custom_row_data HTML is unrestricted/unsanitized (rendered with Twig raw), so only trusted view editors should set it.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a view with machine name vri_known_view whose default display uses the Views Row Insert style. Inspect the live view configuration and state after how many rows it inserts the extra row (the rows_number option value).
evals.expected_output: In views.view.vri_known_view the default display style is row_insert with options.rows_number = 4, so it inserts a row after every 4th row.

evals.prompt: The view vri_known_view on this site uses Views Row Insert to inject custom HTML. Inspect the live configuration and report the marker text contained in the custom content it inserts.
evals.expected_output:
The style options.custom_row_data is '
VRI-PROMO-XYZ
' (data_mode vri_text), so the marker is VRI-PROMO-XYZ.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a view vri_task_view whose default display currently uses the plain 'Unformatted list' (default) style. Using views_row_insert, switch that display's style to Row Insert (row_insert) so it can inject rows, and save the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.vri_task_view the default display display_options.style.type is set to row_insert (e.g. load the View, set the style type to row_insert with sensible options, and save).

evals.prompt: The view vri_reconfig_view on this site already uses the Views Row Insert style, currently inserting after every 2nd row and NOT starting with an inserted row. Reconfigure it to insert after every 5th row and to start the output with an inserted row (the header option), then save to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.vri_reconfig_view the row_insert style options set rows_number = 5 and row_header = true, saved to the live view entity.
